text: Civil engineering aims to "ensure the safety, durability and economy of engineering facilities", and its research subjects cover various types of engineering from the surface to the underground, and from microscopic materials to macroscopic structures. Not only do we need to solve technical problems such as wind resistance and earthquake resistance of bridges, and stability of tunnel surrounding rocks, but we also need to balance engineering costs with social demands (such as cost-effective design for rural roads);We not only focus on the implementation of individual projects (such as a bridge spanning a river), but also involve the collaborative construction of large-scale engineering systems (such as high-speed rail networks and urban underground pipe galleries);The final outcome is "visible and usable physical projects", which directly relates to public safety (such as building earthquake resistance), economic development (such as logistics channels), and people's well-being (such as flood control projects).
